changes.name: ExtendedIslandProgression
changes.source:
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")
local Players=game:GetService("Players")

-- Extend progression beyond the original four stages.
local stages={
 {name="SkyGarden",pos=Vector3.new(42,20,42),size=Vector3.new(30,3,30),color=Color3.fromRGB(105,205,110)},
 {name="LavaIsland",pos=Vector3.new(76,20,42),size=Vector3.new(30,3,30),color=Color3.fromRGB(75,75,75)},
 {name="CloudBridge",pos=Vector3.new(108,21,42),size=Vector3.new(34,2,10),color=Color3.fromRGB(225,235,245)},
 {name="AncientIsland",pos=Vector3.new(140,20,42),size=Vector3.new(34,4,34),color=Color3.fromRGB(170,145,95)},
 {name="MoonIsland",pos=Vector3.new(140,28,82),size=Vector3.new(34,4,34),color=Color3.fromRGB(155,165,185)},
 {name="VoidBridge",pos=Vector3.new(108,29,82),size=Vector3.new(34,2,10),color=Color3.fromRGB(90,60,130)},
 {name="VoidIsland",pos=Vector3.new(76,28,82),size=Vector3.new(34,4,34),color=Color3.fromRGB(65,45,90)},
 {name="FinalRealm",pos=Vector3.new(38,28,82),size=Vector3.new(38,4,38),color=Color3.fromRGB(80,170,210)}
}
local made={}
for _,d in ipairs(stages) do
 local p=Instance.new("Part")
 p.Name=d.name;p.Size=d.size;p.Position=d.pos-Vector3.new(0,12,0);p.Anchored=true;p.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic;p.Color=d.color;p.Transparency=1;p.CanCollide=false;p.Parent=world
 made[#made+1]={part=p,target=d.pos}
end

local core=world:WaitForChild("EnergyCore")
local prompt=core:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
local busy={}

local function updatePrompt(player)
 if not prompt then return end
 local st=player:FindFirstChild("IslandStage")
 if st and st.Value>=4 and st.Value<12 then prompt.ActionText="Grow Island - 1 Energy" end
 if st and st.Value>=12 then prompt.ActionText="Realm Complete!" end
end

local function reveal(index)
 local info=made[index-4]
 if not info or info.part.Transparency<1 then return end
 info.part.Transparency=0
 info.part.CanCollide=true
 info.part.Position=info.target
end

for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do updatePrompt(p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p) task.wait(1);updatePrompt(p) end)

if prompt then
 prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
  local stage=player:FindFirstChild("IslandStage")
  local energy=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Energy")
  if not stage or not energy or busy[player] then return end
  -- Original game handles stages 1-4. We take over after stage 4.
  if stage.Value>=4 and stage.Value<12 then
   busy[player]=true
   if energy.Value>=1 then
    energy.Value-=1
    stage.Value+=1
    reveal(stage.Value)
    updatePrompt(player)
   end
   task.delay(.35,function() busy[player]=nil end)
  end
 end)
end

print("Extended island progression loaded: 12 total stages")
